newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Q1 wholesale trade sales fall 4.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Q1 wholesale trade sales fall 4.8 percent.

text.p: South Africa's first quarter wholesale trade sales at constant prices fell 4.8 percent against the same period last year, adding to signals that consumer demand is slowing.

Total sales for the month of March, excluding diamonds, were 18.57 billion rand which was a decrease of 5.3 percent at constant June 1995 prices from March last year, the Central Statistical Service (CSS) said on Thursday.

Wholesalers in the foodstuffs, beverage and tobacco industries saw their sales decrease by 16.1 in the quarter but this was due mainly to restructuring which removed some firms from the wholesale category, the CSS said.
The CSS earlier unveiled a surprise 0.8 percent fall in seasonally adjusted and annualised Gross Domestic Product for the quarter to March after a rise of 3.3 percent for the December quarter, 1996.
